title: catalog-resource-policy
description: A named suspension/reconciliation policy referenced by `catalog-plan.resource_policy_id` (issue #92). It governs what happens to an existing deployment when its subscription enters `suspended`/`grace_period`/`expired` - separately from whether NEW provisioning or upgrades are blocked. `existing_healthy_deployments_action` defaults to `keep_running` in every fixture in this contract set; AGENTS.md and issue #92 both require that suspension never silently stops a healthy existing deployment unless a policy explicitly says so.
